bootstrap.scope: conditional on three trained members; training seed spread descriptive, not a posterior over retraining

data.frontend_fit: paired TRAIN context reports only, device0 report gauge

diagnostics.direct_same_link_frequency: sourceA5.2GHz report at same pose/AP minus learned sourceoffset +20log10(5.2/6) plus learned queryoffset; fixed material response assumption, descriptive only
diagnostics.held_device_onboarding_scope: simulated relative RSSI offset/quantization inverse; sourceviewA remains knowndevice0. Not neural held-device encoder transfer, hardware AGC/CFO/RF calibration, or independently sampled support sets
diagnostics.onboarding_scope: context-only support, disjoint from odd-pose queries; descriptive
diagnostics.onboarding_unavailable_rule: Only this descriptive assay: insufficient genuine context pairs or no heard held-device query -> explicitly unavailable per geometry/N, retain actual available context count/heard query count/reason/denominator; no substitute RF, replacement scene/N, or invented labels. Main RF and held-band queries/gates remain mandatory.
diagnostics.shuffle_latent: across-layout roll by one on sourceviewA, same query geometry, all3seeds
diagnostics.source_view_b: not evaluated in this finite phase; used as paired training view only

metrics.censored: separate interval/censor Gaussian NLL, no invented point labels
metrics.heard_rmse: root mean squared error of quantized reported-RSSI centers, heard reports only

held_band_query_axes.scope: same physical context links, unseen6GHz only

metrics.p95_absolute_error: 95th percentile absolute heard-report error within geometry, then mean across layouts
metrics.seed_aggregation: calculate each trained member metric separately, then arithmetic mean within geometry

name: independent-spectral-scene-field-study

neural.alignment: direct zA/zB MSE, both branches differentiable, no projector/EMA/stopped target
neural.decoder: shared latent8 -> 8 public geometry basis coefficients*10 plus bounded +/-5dB local geometry correction; no RF token/power bypass
neural.geometry_only: RF-value-erased geometry + reported availability control: token dimensions0..3 erased; heard|censored availability mask retained. Not strictly CAD-only; no RF-value necessity claim.

gradient_balance.reference: RMS measurement gradient with respect to (zA,zB)

neural.inverse_initialization: heard-only geometry8 weighted ridge: (B^T W B + .1 I)^-1 B^T W (residual/10), weights .25+1.5 sigmoid(reliability); learned set-attention correction scaled .25 (unbounded, compatible with unit-variance priors)
neural.prior: actual vendored SIGReg or VICReg directly on each view latent across48 layouts
neural.prior_selection: minimum mean per-layout per-seed VALIDATION heard-query RF RMSE; canonical cell order breaks exact ties
neural.target_loss: quantization interval Gaussian likelihood and upper-censor likelihood, fixed4dB; missing unsolved readings excluded
neural.validation_checkpoint: minimum source-view-A mean per-layout heard-query RMSE, first epoch breaks exact tie

operator_only: public free-space operator plus TRAIN-reported front-end calibration; no learned hidden-material correction
